candidates.rootOpinion: Eligible for a static P3 formal issue after final peer/history artifact freeze and formal Git binding; only one global item.
candidates.title: A legal marketplace named local collides with the local-plugin origin marker in uninstall routing
ordinaryPreconditions: Registered marketplace key is the permitted ASCII literal local; e.g. a valid repository with that derived tail.
A plugin is successfully installed from that marketplace through the ordinary marketplace flow.
There is no direct-local plugin directory with the same plugin name, a normal supported state.
candidates.cause: Marketplace name admission does not reserve local. Marketplace install keys use plugin@marketplace, catalog splits that suffix without a separate origin tag, and the UI helper interprets marketplace===local as direct-local.
candidates.staticConsequence: The local uninstall branch looks at plugins/<name> while the ordinary marketplace installation is in plugins/cache/local/<name>/<version>, so its missing-directory guard rejects; the marketplace installation remains. No actual uninstall or filesystem outcome observed.
counterevidence: The legitimate direct-local marker is intentional; old truthy-local missing branch is the reverse direction and is not this admission/namespace issue.
Valid name paths and known registry parser do not reserve local. Local version cache alias R52 and sourceToRepoKey PROFILE-R5-01 are other causes.
No actual deletion, data damage, current user state, or auth/custody weakness is claimed.
candidates.validation: Static repository text only,0 product/helper/fixture/test or business I/O execution.
